subject: [RFC PATCH 05/18] mm: expedite the grace period when a CPU has many deferred frees

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of deferred frees in the Linux kernel by introducing an expedited grace period when a CPU has many pending frees. When more than 4 MiB is pending on a CPU, the patch takes both lists and frees them after an expedited grace period, which interrupts every CPU. This approach aims to reduce memory pressure by freeing up memory quickly when it's needed most, such as when the zone is below its high watermark or when pages waiting in it are more than an eighth of its free pages. The patch also adds a new counter pgfree_rcu_expedite in /proc/vmstat to track the number of expedited runs that freed something.
